title: Listen and Choose a Response — Errands

questions.stem: What time does the pharmacy on Elm Street close tonight?

options.A: I'm not sure, but its hours are posted online.
options.B: It's right across from the post office.
options.C: Yes, the street is closed for repairs.
options.D: I picked up my medicine there last week.

questions.explanation: The speaker wants a closing time; offering a way to find it is a natural indirect reply. The others answer where, repeat 'closed', or describe a past visit.
questions.speaker: m6
